physics-killer-05.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-05.material: Benda massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ obah arah $+x$ kanthi $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Gaya arah $+x$ makarya ing benda iki, gedhene gaya mundhak tetep saka $0$ nganti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ sajrone wektu $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, tetep $40\,\mathrm{N}$ sajrone $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, lan suda tetep saka $40\,\mathrm{N}$ nganti $0$ sajrone $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake gedhene impuls sing ditampa benda sajrone $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ gaya iki makarya, lan kacepetan benda sakwise gaya ilang? (Ora ana gaya liyane.)
